summary: This paper completes a six-paper machine-checked audit series evaluating the thermodynamic channel capacity and intracellular signaling horizons of 71-THz mito-polariton waveguides. By rigorously establishing Giovannetti-Holevo classical capacities, heterodyne/homodyne receiver penalty gaps (10.99x), unassisted quantum capacity walls (Q=0 for eta <= 1/2), and bioenergetic signaling horizons under metabolic power budgets, the work provides a definitive, machine-verified physical boundary against unverified biological photonics claims.

AST-audited zero-float/zero-slash/zero-power Python verifier with 58 adversarial pytest checks.
